Incident Report - Companion Animal Travel Desk, Aurelia Skyways

On the day of travel, the Companion Animal Travel Desk received notice that the flight handling Frankie’s booking would be impacted by a delayed departure. Mariam Khan and Priya Osei were already at the airport when the schedule shift came through, and their pet transport connection became at risk. The senior coordinator reviewed the situation calmly and started a stepwise escalation so Frankie could remain secure, comfortable, and aligned with the carrier plan.

The standard payout for the delayed departure incident is $57.

Handling began with confirmation of Frankie’s status, including the escort arrangement and the readiness of the companion handling team. Next, our desk coordinated with airport staff to keep Frankie’s care continuous during the hold, and we adjusted the travel instructions so the staff at the next handoff would be fully briefed. We then documented the timeline and communicated updates to the travelers in plain language, focusing on what would happen next and what to expect for pickup.

For follow-up, the desk logged the disruption details for internal review and used the case notes to tighten our delay-prep checklist. The travelers were acknowledged for their cooperation, and we verified that the payout process was completed without further delay. Service Writer, Companion Animal Travel Desk
